name: Gohl
description: A horned orc youth in Mehtma's cohort, trapped in the rubble after the barrage and rescued by Mehtma.

timeline.summary: Mehtma leads her seven charges, including Enti and Gohl, into the Kin-Tree chamber to be accepted into House Fenzala as adults.
timeline.quote: Today the Kin-Tree will accept you into our house with the full honors and responsibilities of an adult.

timeline.summary: Mehtma and Vauti rally onlookers to lift a fallen beam and Mehtma crawls beneath it to reach three trapped youths including Gohl.
timeline.quote: The beam precariously balanced above her, she shimmied in,

timeline.summary: Mehtma drags one youth out just before Vauti lets the beam drop, and tells Gohl to take charge of the others.
timeline.quote: Vauti bugled, and the beam dropped with a heavy thud.
